observed: Re-recording preflight invalidated old route/execute gates. A PowerShell batch continued after nonzero controller exits and launched the development runner before Q002 could register.
quality_effect: No treatment, dataset, gold, model, execution budget or scoring changed. This is a workflow-recording defect, not a model outcome.
recovery: Inspected the in-flight run; did not launch a duplicate or hide its result. Repassed route and execute gates and registered Q002 as recovery of the actual original process.
prevent_recurrence: Dependent controller calls are now sequential tool calls with explicit exit-code checks before subsequent launch.
